description.en: Open terminals on any host you can reach over SSH. The other machine needs no cmux, and cmux checks its host key before it connects.
description.ja: SSH で接続できるホストならどこでもターミナルを開けます。相手のマシンに cmux は不要で、接続の前に cmux がホスト鍵を確認します。

tagline.en: Open terminals on any SSH host, no cmux needed on the other end
tagline.ja: SSH で入れるホストでターミナルを開けます。相手側に cmux は不要です

connection.reason: Open a shell on the SSH hosts you pick. cmux connects, checks the host key you accepted and signs in with your key; the app never sees the key.
